int_name: RISING SUN AVE & E ROOSEVELT BLVD

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection that lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The expansive roadway creates long crossing distances and high exposure to vehicle traffic, resulting in a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at this large intersection, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane roadway requires a long duration of exposure to traffic for any pedestrian attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe for people to cross the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Utilize the existing median space to create raised refuge islands, allowing pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with a long, unprotected pedestrian crossing. While a marked crosswalk is present, the markings are faded and there is no median refuge or visible pedestrian signalization to support safe crossing of the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Fencing and signage on the right corner may obstruct sightlines and narrow the available pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the Dunkin' property

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility, durable thermoplastic markings.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and tactile curb ramps, but the overall environment is dominated by high-speed arterial design. The long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island or physical buffer between the sidewalk and traffic create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center-right

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation like trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the high-speed traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide multi-lane arterial boulevard with significant crossing distances and high traffic volumes. While basic infrastructure like crosswalks and medians are present, the scale of the roadway and the speed of traffic create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the boulevard requires pedestrians to cross many lanes of traffic, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway of Roosevelt Blvd

hazards.name: High Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide lanes and the arterial design of the road encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury in a collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes of the boulevard

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to better alert drivers to the crossing.
